description: Department of Wild Life Conservation - The Fauna and Flor Protection Ordinance ( Chapter 469)
categorisation: The gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument. It is an Order made under a specific ordinance (The Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance) that rescinds a previous order and declares a specific area of land to be a Nature Reserve. This fits the definition of Type 5, which includes statutory instruments, subsidiary legislation, and regulatory actions. While a Minister's name is present, the core content is the exercise of a statutory power to create a regulation, not a government personnel change or a description of ministerial portfolios.
